data.name: Uanamon: Jamacy
data.detailed_description:
Uanamon: Jamacy is a fast, surreal roguelike about ideas that refuse to die — and a world that mutates every time you blink.
You play as a lone Jamacy, a tiny creature born from pure intention, thrown into a chaotic universe where thoughts take physical shape, logic melts into dream-rules, and every run rewrites reality around you.

This isn’t a place you explore.
It’s a place you survive, reshape, and eventually bend to your will.

Features

• Fast-paced roguelike combat with tight controls and fluid movement
• Dozens of evolving abilities that combine into unpredictable synergies
• Procedural worlds inspired by surrealism, emotions, and dream-logic
• A growing Uanamon Universe, where every character and object holds hidden meaning
• Permanent progression that rewards skill, experimentation, and persistence
• A unique vibe — playful, strange, philosophical, and alive
